_readme: Municipal GENERAL TAX RATES by year, per $100 of assessed value.
This file drives the 'Tax History' chart on property-lookup.html.
NJ Division of Taxation publishes 'General Tax Rates by County and Municipality'
every year. Search that phrase on nj.gov/treasury/taxation. Each year is its own table.
The key must match the MUN_NAME value the parcel service returns, uppercased.
You can see that value in the 'Municipality' row of any lookup result.
Then add one entry per year you have a rate for.
If a town name appears in more than one county, append the county in parentheses
exactly as shown here and the page will match on town + county.
The chart estimates each year's bill as (assessed value x rate) / 100.
That is an estimate. It uses the CURRENT assessment against each historical rate,
so it shows what rate movement did to the bill, not reassessment history.
The page says so on screen. Leave this file empty and the chart hides itself.
Delete the example below once you add real numbers.
